Conceded: [E3] and [E13]. While trailing profit growth is negative [E13] and the dividend yield is zero [E3], focusing solely on backward-looking metrics ignores powerful forward-looking momentum and structural growth. The company is actively participating in robust sector tailwinds where median sales growth reaches 17.9% and median profit growth hits 19.0% [E37, E38]. Crucially, the operational engine is firing with verified momentum: sales are up quarter-over-quarter and earnings growth is actively accelerating [E32, E33]. This operational turnaround is backed by exceptional multi-year performance, delivering a 36% compounded sales growth over 10 years [E12]. Furthermore, long-term investors have been richly rewarded by this underlying expansion through an 18% compounded share price growth over 10 years and a 46% compounded share price growth over 5 years [E14, E15]. Finally, the company demonstrates superior capital efficiency compared to its peer group, holding a vastly superior return on assets of -21.01% against a distressed sector benchmark of -171.35% [E7].

Conceded: [E12], [E14], and [E15]. While the bull highlights a 36% compounded 10-year sales growth [E12] alongside multi-year share price gains [E14, E15], these historical milestones provide zero comfort against an acute collapse in trailing profitability where compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months stands at -79% [E13]. The bull attempts to mask this severe earnings deterioration by pointing to sector tailwinds and short-term screen signals [E32, E33, E37, E38], yet these qualitative tailwinds fail to offset a negative price-to-earnings ratio of -59.52x which heavily underperforms the sector benchmark of 35.78x [E5]. Furthermore, the bull leans on a negative return on assets of -21.01% as a relative victory against the sector benchmark [E7], but ignores the mathematical reality of a negative book value of -1.02 resulting in an alarming price-to-book ratio of -24.80x [E1]. Finally, zero dividend yield [E3] combined with contracting trailing profits [E13] and deeply distressed valuation multiples [E1, E5] demonstrates that current operational momentum is entirely failing to translate into shareholder value.
